Description: Urdu users get a "Get Urdu text" button on Sahih Muslim that can never work
Steps: Set app language Urdu > Hadith > Sahih Muslim > download > press Get Urdu text
Expected: Button hidden when the source has no Urdu for that book
Actual: urd-muslim file is 404 on jsDelivr; fetch error is swallowed; pack installs without ur; button stays | 2026-11-16 emulator: Urdu text DID load for Muslim - served from the Supabase content bucket (tried first). Only the jsDelivr fallback lacks urd-muslim. | 2026-11-16 23:05: urd-muslim.min.json now 200 on jsDelivr - the earlier 404 was a temporary CDN miss. Urdu on emulator came from jsDelivr.
Root cause: Latent: if the (paused) Supabase bucket goes away, the jsDelivr fallback 404s and the button can never work
Fix (proposed): Per-book language list (muslim: bn only) or hide button after a failed fetch
Regression test: Unit test: muslim + ur => no extra language offered
